title: United Baptist Church burned 1963
description: At approximately 10:30 a.m. on Wednesday, October 16, 1963, a fire broke out in the basement of the United Baptist Church, on the site where the rebuilt Baptist Church stands today, while workers were performing repairs. Upstairs, a Philathea class was quilting when they detected the smell of smoke and sounded the alarm. Firefighters from Hartland responded immediately and were soon joined by crews from Woodstock and Florenceville. The sprawling building, enclosed with a steel roof, made firefighting efforts especially challenging. Thick clouds of smoke billowed from the doors and eaves as flames rapidly climbed the partitions. Another devastating loss for Hartland, a historic church built in 1898.
